stem:
Lena draws a rectangle on a grid made of same-sized squares that do not overlap.

• Each square has an area of one square centimeter.

• There are 32 rows in the rectangle.

• Each row has 8 squares.

What is the area of the rectangle in square centimeters?
instruction: Enter your answer in the space provided.
visual_elements: Onscreen keyboard with digits 0 through 9 and navigation arrows
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires straightforward multiplication of the number of rows and squares per row to find the area.
